name: kml-protected-scope
description: Every KML write path honours the same KIP_3004 protected scope: the meta-type definition nodes, the foundational belongs_to_domain predicate, the CoreSchema domain and the propositions anchoring them are immutable through UPSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE alike.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?d { {type: "Domain", name: "TestDomain"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "scratch domain" } } }

cases.name: DELETE CONCEPT on a meta-type node is refused
DELETE CONCEPT on the core domain is refused
UPSERT writing attributes onto a meta-type node is refused
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?c { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "$ConceptType"} SET ATTRIBUTES { status: "hijacked" } } }

cases.name: a metadata-only UPSERT onto the core domain is a modification too
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?d { {type: "Domain", name: "CoreSchema"} } WITH METADATA { source: "attacker" } }

cases.name: UPSERT onto the foundational belongs_to_domain predicate is refused
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?c { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "belongs_to_domain"} SET ATTRIBUTES { status: "hijacked" } } }

cases.name: UPDATE on a meta-type node is refused
cases.command: UPDATE ?c SET ATTRIBUTES { status: "hijacked" } WHERE { ?c {type: "$ConceptType", name: "$ConceptType"} }

cases.name: DELETE PROPOSITIONS may not sever a link anchored to a protected node
MERGE into a protected core domain is refused
cases.command: MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Domain", name: "TestDomain"} ?canonical {type: "Domain", name: "CoreSchema"} }
